title: How to give healing skills and items animations?

posts.author: Camerong307
posts.body: This is in front view battle mode. I was hoping to have an animation play whenever a character uses a healing item and healing skills, but have had no luck. So far only screen animations play when the skill targets an enemy. Most of what I could find in terms of plugins were about side view mode. Any help is greatly appreciated.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: This is just a guess right now, but… what if you use an animation whose position is "Screen"? Does it still not show? Many of the default animations use a position of "Feet", "Head", or "Center", which doesn't really make sense for something targeting an ally in front-view, since there is no sprite to attach it to.

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body: That's just simply a problem with front view in RPG Maker that animations on the party don't show up in front view. You'll either need a plugin that puts somewhere for the animation to happen and/or move the side view characters to the front of the screen (likely requires a plugin and different sheets for them to become front view). I sadly don't remember which plugins can fix that (I use Yanfly but I generally try not to suggest paid plugins for new members).
